asha: Quick check-in: ACME wants an "Optimize Advisor" pilot in ~6w. I think we should aggressively cut scope to three deliverables: 1) batching guidance + one-click apply, 2) simple KV/prefix cache for chat, 3) quant recommendation engine with safety rollback triggered by evals. Thoughts?

tim: That scope makes sense. For batching: surface batch sizes and latency tradeoffs per route and add a simulated cost savings calc. Keep the auto-apply behind a confirm + canary.

jorge: Cache: implement prefix KV cache and a policy to expire keys by conversation id and token age. MVP should expose cache hit rate and p50/p95 latency delta.

kevin: Quant: limit MVP to conservative int8 presets. Must include a fast-looking eval harness that runs on a customer-provided eval set and can reject a quant suggestion if quality drops.

asha: Proposed minimal acceptance list:
```
- Batching advisor: gives top-3 suggestions, includes delta estimate (tokens/$), and has "apply as rollout" option (canary 5%)
- Prefix cache: visible hit-rate metric and >25% reduction in repeated-prefix compute on our internal chat bench
- Quant recs: int8 presets + eval gate; automatic revert to fp16 if eval threshold crossed
- Eval-triggered alert: sends webhook + one example failure; default threshold = abs drop 3% or rel 10%
```

tim: On the threshold, recommend default abs 3% but allow customers to set either absolute OR relative. Also log the distribution of deltas to help tuning.

jorge: Operational constraints: we can't add per-route baseline tuning for MVP. Offer per-project baseline with docs on constructing eval sets.

kevin: Also, add a rollback safety: any applied quant change must be pinned to a model-version alias and auto-reverted if eval fails twice consecutively within 24h.

asha: Good call. Who picks up the ship items? I can draft the pilot one-pager and ACs today.

eng-bot: created ticket RED-2401: optimize-advisor-mvp-slim, assigned @asha; link: https://phabricator.internal/RED-2401

asha: Tim take the batching UI + cost calc spec. Jorge owns cache implementation + metrics. Kevin owns quant presets + eval harness. I'll own pilot coordination + customer onboarding doc.

tim: I'll mock the UI flows and include a "preview impact" run that simulates a 1-hour window based on recent traces.

jorge: I'll add observability: cache hit heatmap, per-conversation TTL distribution, and estimated saved tokens metric.

kevin: I'll run quick int8 vs fp16 quality benchmarks on our representative models and post numbers in the ticket.

asha: Final decision: shrink MVP to those three items, defer per-route thresholds, per-GPU fine-tuning, and long-term telemetry retention to post-MVP. If anything blocks the 6w timeline, call it out here before EOD.

tim: Copy that.

jorge: 👍

kevin: 👍

asha: Thanks — I'll post the one-pager and schedule a 30m alignment tomorrow.
